when: At fixed-point conversion, after raw headers have been bound to provisional source keys. The parser does not apply this table.
baseline: Community Edition 2.670 (issue #37). The factors are the SFC1-lineage hypothesis recorded in docs/formats/shiplist.md. They are not confirmed on the CE 2.670 install.

factors.note: Each of the four file cells is multiplied by 2. The two side cells are written to two indices each. The live side-column factor, end factor, and pairing are the fallbacks in measured.json until an override is set.
The file stores one side-engine rating. The loader doubles it, then adds the unscaled centre engine.
moveCost, crew counts, box counts, weapon counts and drone reloads are not doubled.
